question: I don't want to build all the stage containers myself. Where do I get the Auto-Labeling images, and do I need to log in to nvcr.io?
ground_truth: Response uses the auto-labeling skill and routes to the ngc-containers reference. It explains that the stage images are public in the NGC Catalog under nvcr.io/nvidia/cdf-* with the 1.1.0 release tag, that anonymous pulls work so docker login nvcr.io is optional, and that an authenticated login uses the literal username $oauthtoken with an NGC personal API key passed through --password-stdin from an environment variable. It recommends dry-running the cookbook to find the images the run needs, then running make pull with NGC_IMAGES limited to those images so each image is tagged with the local cdf-* name the workflow runner expects, and verifying with docker image ls and another dry run.
